title: Concept: Server trust accepted from the challenge without evaluation in swift — review required
description: In swift, server trust is wrapped into a credential and handed back to the session. TLS certificate validation is an active step: the chain must be evaluated against a policy before the connection is accepted. Skipping that step keeps encryption but removes authentication.
applicability: swift iOS apps with custom URLSession delegates.
risk: Certificate substitution and traffic interception; HIGH severity.
